Night thirty. I can't feel my fingers. They're not cold. They're... smooth.
My reflection in the costume room mirror didn't blink when I did. It was a second late. Then two seconds.
I tried to go home this morning. I walked to the front door. Then I turned left and did the patrol route again. I didn't decide to. My feet did.
If anybody finds this. My name is Gary Finch. I was a night guard. I think I still am. I think I always will be.
